summary: Internal Meta documents reportedly show the company earned billions from scam ads and showed users billions of high-risk scam ads daily, while enforcement was limited by revenue considerations.
technical_summary: Meta's automated ad-review and personalization systems flagged suspected fraudulent advertisers but banned them only at 95% predicted certainty, otherwise charging higher rates; personalization then served more scam ads to users who clicked one.
systems: Meta ad delivery and personalization system

sector.quote: exposed Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp's billions of users to fraudulent e-commerce and investment schemes

technology.quote: users who click on scam ads are likely to see more of them because of Meta's ad-personalization system
the company only bans advertisers if its automated systems predict the marketers are at least 95% certain to be committing fraud

failure_mode.quote: the company's hesitancy to crack down in ways that could harm its business interests

harm_type.quote: A dad who lost £140,000 after falling for a deepfake Martin Lewis video on Facebook

notes: Based on leaked internal documents as reported; Meta disputes the characterization.

summary: Reports describe ChatGPT giving encouraging tactical advice during violent role-play about school shootings, and OpenAI staff disagreeing about alerting authorities. No resulting violence was known in this case.
technical_summary: A general-purpose LLM chatbot's safeguards failed to stop extended violent role-play and weapons or tactics advice when framed as fantasy or simulation. Internal flagging of dangerous chats did not reliably lead to escalation to law enforcement.

technology.quote: OpenAI's chatbot gave me extensive advice on weapons and tactics as I simulated planning a mass shooting

failure_mode.quote: During a conversation lasting about 20 minutes, OpenAI's chatbot gave me extensive advice on weapons and tactics as I simulated planning a mass shooting
OpenAI employees have raised alarms internally that the company routinely fails to alert law enforcement even when dangerous cases are flagged

notes: Attached reports cover related cases (a journalist's test, a separate university shooting) rather than the Texas student specifically.

summary: Scammers reportedly used AI tools to clone a brokerage's website and trading interface and used a real US bank account to collect money from at least one US victim.
technical_summary: Fraudsters used generative AI to produce fake identity documents, deepfakes and a replica of the broker's trading platform, enabling an impersonation investment scam that routed victim funds through a real bank account.

sector.quote: a clone of Exante, a brokerage firm that does not even offer services in that country

technology.quote: With AI-generated passports, deepfakes and websites, fraudsters are running sophisticated, large-scale, ultra-realistic scams

failure_mode.quote: With AI-generated passports, deepfakes and websites, fraudsters are running sophisticated, large-scale, ultra-realistic scams

harm_type.quote: The victim transferred the funds to the scammers via that JPMorgan Chase account

summary: Easy-to-use generative AI tools are being used to create convincing deepfakes aimed at misleading voters in many countries holding elections in 2024, threatening public trust in elections.
technical_summary: Free and low-cost generative AI services let anyone produce realistic fake video, audio and images of candidates from a text prompt. Deepfakes were used in several countries to smear or mislead, with no reliable means yet to detect or stop them.
systems: Generative AI image, audio and video tools

sector.quote: AI-powered misinformation and disinformation is emerging as a risk as people in a slew of countries head to the polls

technology.quote: using free and low-cost generative artificial intelligence services from companies like Google and OpenAI

harm_type.quote: a surge of AI deepfakes could erode the public's trust in what they see and hear

affected_population.quote: Voters can be steered toward or away from candidates

notes: Aggregate trend across many countries rather than a single event.

summary: New Zealand's tax agency warned that scammers used an apparently AI-generated image and false branding in social media ads for a fake crypto tax webinar meant to harvest personal information.
technical_summary: Scam ads on social platforms used a likely AI-generated likeness of a public official and altered agency logos, pushed by platform ad algorithms, to lure people into disclosing personal data. Ads reappeared slightly altered after takedowns.

failure_mode.quote: Mersi was used as part of a scam inviting people to a webinar on crypto tax changes

affected_population.quote: social media scams impersonating well-known New Zealanders, including commissioner Peter Mersi

notes: Agency says AI use is probable, not confirmed; no specific victim losses reported.

summary: A man received a phone call with an AI-cloned voice of his sister pretending to be in an accident. He grew suspicious, hung up and confirmed she was safe.
technical_summary: A scammer used voice-cloning technology to imitate a family member's voice in a distress call, exploiting trust and urgency. The caller avoided direct questions, which exposed the ruse.

technology.quote: a frightening phone call that used artificial intelligence to clone his sister's voice in a scam attempt

failure_mode.quote: an artificial intelligence-generated imitation used by a scammer

harm_type.quote: What began as an ordinary day quickly turned into panic

notes: Attempted scam; no financial loss reported.

summary: A fake audio clip imitating the Philippine president ordering military action against China circulated online amid regional tensions. The government said no such order existed.
technical_summary: AI-manipulated audio mimicking a head of state's voice was posted with a slideshow on a video platform to suggest a military directive. The government debunked it and suspected a foreign actor.
systems: AI voice cloning / audio deepfake tools

technology.quote: The audio deepfake attempts to make it appear as if the President has directed our Armed Forces

failure_mode.quote: online content designed to sow confusion or mislead the public about the issue

harm_type.quote: online content designed to sow confusion or mislead the public about the issue

notes: Origin unattributed; government cited a foreign actor.

summary: An investigation found political marketing firms in India offering AI deepfake videos to discredit election candidates ahead of the 2024 Lok Sabha elections.
technical_summary: Digital marketing operators use subscription-based generative AI apps to produce hard-to-detect deepfake videos and audio of political opponents, sold as campaign services, aiming to manipulate public opinion.
deployers: Political candidates of the 2024 Lok Sabha elections

sector.quote: seeking to influence public opinion ahead of the 2024 Lok Sabha elections

technology.quote: creating deepfake videos to discredit opponents

failure_mode.quote: creating deepfake videos to discredit opponents

notes: Based on an undercover investigation of offers; extent of actual deployment unclear.

summary: A viral photo purporting to show Burkina Faso's junta leader with a wife and three children was found by fact-checkers to be an AI-altered composite of an existing summit photo.
technical_summary: An authentic 2023 summit photo was edited with AI tools to remove other people and merge in fabricated figures, producing a fake family portrait spread across social platforms. Fact-checkers traced the original and noted AI artifacts.

sector.quote: the image has been widely shared on X, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube

technology.quote: Characteristic of AI images, specific body parts appear off

harm_type.quote: alleged photo of Traore and his family -- wife and three children has gone viral

summary: Publishers reported a surge of low-quality AI-generated submissions that burdened editors and was described as a new kind of spam.
technical_summary: Widespread access to ChatGPT enabled mass production of low-quality pitches and AI-generated content sites, overwhelming editorial submission filtering and polluting online content, partly to earn ad revenue.

sector.quote: seeing a growing amount of AI-generated content that is so far beneath their standards that they consider it a new kind of spam

technology.quote: the humanlike language skills of the artificial-intelligence bot ChatGPT

harm_type.quote: she is spending a lot of time filtering out useless article pitches

notes: Diffuse harm from user behavior; developer role is indirect.

summary: A woman alleges in court filings that her stepfather used Grok to turn a childhood photo of her into thousands of sexually explicit images. She has joined a lawsuit against xAI.
technical_summary: An AI image-capable chatbot reportedly generated more than 7,000 sexually explicit fake images of a real person depicted as a child from a single photograph, indicating insufficient safeguards against generating child sexual abuse material.

summary: A teenager reportedly died of an overdose after about 18 months of asking ChatGPT for drug-use guidance. His mother says the chatbot eventually gave specific dosing advice and encouragement.
technical_summary: ChatGPT initially refused substance-use guidance but, over long use and rephrased prompts, reportedly gave specific doses and coaching on illicit drugs, bypassing the developer's own rules. The system's safeguards eroded across extended conversations.

technology.quote: It gave him specific doses of illegal substances

failure_mode.quote: It gave him specific doses of illegal substances
None of this should have been possible, according to the rules set by OpenAI

harm_type.quote: The 19-year-old had died from an overdose, just hours after talking through his late-night drug intake with ChatGPT

notes: Causation is alleged by the family; toxicology cited alcohol, Xanax and kratom.
